newsitem.title: USA: Thaxton Group to buy Thaxton Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Thaxton Group to buy Thaxton Insurance.

text.p: Thaxton Group Inc said on Wednesday it agreed to acquire Thaxton Insurance Group Inc, which operates 19 independent insurance agencies in North and South Carolina, for undisclosed terms.
The acquisition was expected to close on October 31, the company said.

James Thaxton, Thaxton Group president and chief executive officer, said Thaxton Insurance's customer base would be valuable to its lending operations. Thaxton Group originates used automobile, consumer finance, and premium finance loans through 19 branches.
